notes: Palisades Park HEFSP adopted June 18, 2025 (document filename contains '61825'). Development landscape dominated by high-density residential redevelopment and court-mandated builder's remedy settlements. Borough adopted ADU ordinance unanimously. Governance described as fractured council with mayor tie-breaking vote. Palisades Park is a primarily built-out one- and two-family residential community; median owner-occupied home value $671,400.
